Method.name: Method
Method.definition: Method by which the original undertaking or proposed amendment is to be made available.

DeliverToPartyType.name: Deliver To Party Type
DeliverToPartyType.definition: Type of party to whom the original undertaking or proposed amendment is intended to be delivered.

DeliverToName.name: Deliver To Name
DeliverToName.definition: Name of party to whom the original undertaking or proposed amendment is intended to be delivered.

DeliverToAddress.name: Deliver To Address
DeliverToAddress.definition: Address of party to whom the original undertaking or proposed amendment is intended to be delivered.

DeliverToPartyTypeSPECAddressRule.definition: If DeliverToPartyType is SpecifiedAddress (SPEC), then DeliverToAddress must be present.
